exposure: Intrathecal morphine (ITM) 0.1 mg during spinal anaesthesia
cohort: 30 ASA physical status I and II, term parturients with BMI less than 40 planned for elective caesarean delivery under spinal anaesthesia with ITM.
finding: Low dose intrathecal morphine (0.1 mg) administered to healthy parturients for caesarean delivery did not significantly change oxygen desaturation index (ODI) or cause respiratory depression compared to baseline.
